# mxroute_spam_settings (Data Source)

Read spam controls through an owned access domain. Sender lists are account-wide; access_domain does not own a separate copy. Complete successful list reads are required. Settings unavailable, unverifiable account context and ambiguous lists are errors. Collection completeness and runtime behavior remain live-unverified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_spam_settings" "account" {
  access_domain = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_domain` (String) Owned canonical domain used as the API access context; a missing domain is an error.

### Read-Only

- `high_score` (Number) Current score, 1–50. Saves affect shared account scoring as well as the selected domain. Exact cross-domain propagation remains live-unverified.
